verdict.rationale: Google's own Data API docs point developers to official client libraries in seven languages (Java, Python, Node.js, PHP, C#, Go, Ruby) with a quickstart. These SDKs sit on top of documented programmatic APIs: the Data API for reporting, the Admin API for configuration, and the Measurement Protocol for collection. The SDK evidence itself is a single first-party sentence, so depth is not shown. missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference or quickstart content in the pack, explicit evidence that client libraries also cover the Admin API, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To get started with a client library in Java, Python, Node.js, PHP, C#, Go, or Ruby, see the client library quickstart.
You can use the Data API to programmatically access Google Analytics report data.
